name: Sumerechnyj les
source: On a summer break, the protagonist makes a visit to her grandmother, who she hasn't seen in many years. She has no special desire to visit her, as her childhood memories remember her as an old crazy hag that lives in a small house near the twilight forest, but feels conveyed to do so.
translation: 暑假期间，主人公去探望多年未见的祖母。她并不特别想去，因为童年记忆中的祖母是住在暮色森林旁小屋里的疯狂老太婆，但还是觉得自己应该去。
